description: Collect a bounded batch of live WebSocket events, then return and unsubscribe. Always terminates: ends when maxEvents (default 20, cap 100) or timeoutMs (default 10000, cap 30000) hits first. filters is a per-channel bag using WS shapes — note `sources` is an ARRAY (unlike REST list tools' singular `source`). Valid keys: trades: sources, mints, wallets, minVolumeUsd, maxVolumeUsd, solOnly (quote assets SOL/USDC/USDT rejected in mints — use solOnly for SOL pairs); transfers: wallets, mints, minVolumeUsd, maxVolumeUsd, direction ('in'/'out', needs wallets) — no sources; Starter plans must pass wallets (≤25) or mints (≤10); creations: sources, enriched, excludeMayhem; graduations: sources, excludeMayhem, minLiquiditySol; prices: sources, mints. Trades and transfers carry each token's `symbol` (null until resolved; key on mint). A routed swap arrives as one trade per hop with the same signature. Use for short live watches / summaries, not history (history → list_* tools).

filters.description: Per-channel filter bag (WS filter shape). See the tool description for the valid keys per channel; uses `sources` (array), not `source`.
